text_block_list.text:
Cultural exchange festival with overseas 
horse girls hastily arranged.
During hectic preparations—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three... flags sufficient. Place 
campus map right by entrance. Keep traffic 
flow in mind!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Welcome Gate is face of academy! Work with 
dignity, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-senpai looks so gallant...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Always cool and composed... Giving crisp 
orders... so dreamy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You two, don't stop. Handle extra balloon 
decorations.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Cultural exchange is chance to recognize 
each other's virtues and improve together. 
Put your heart into it.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yeees!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Found you! Air Groove-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What is it, Scarlet? Did you run here?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, urgent matter to consult! Umm, ah 
jeez, what was it again...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right, special trophy exhibition along 
path to grounds...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Student council already finalized list. 
Check sheet and line up specified items in 
order.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Also, flower arrangement orders for VIP 
seats won't make it in time!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No issue. We rented nearby greenhouse to 
grow moth orchids.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just in full bloom now. Split up and carry 
several pots over.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...!! Arranging right away!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hold on, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Eh! Eep!? Senpai...?

Stopping Daiwa Scarlet as she dashed off, 
Air Groove combed through her hair with 
fingers.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Your hair is messy. Unlike you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Likely pressured by everyone into hoarding 
every task, big and small.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Do not overexert yourself. ...I will lend 
hand later.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-senpai... So reassuring!

Air Groove's thoughtfulness seemed to 
restore her composure.
